description: Fix coupled workflow lifecycle invariants: failed Runic Runnable must durably fail WorkflowRun before sibling success can mask it; interrupt_run must lock/reload authoritative persisted state; UI and lifecycle observer dispatch failures must not alter committed state. Action reuse: local-only orchestration in WorkflowRunAgent/Workflows; no reusable Action applies because these are persistence and driver-state ownership internals. Verify existing three regressions plus stale completed interruption regression, focused suites, mix q.

comments.text: PR #765 lifecycle follow-up: reproduced stale pending start, stale paused resume, stale DAG-build failure overwriting cancellation, and pause/cancel losing to RunWatcher when API is traced and suspended at transaction entry beyond 200 ms. Fixed via locked pending/paused -> running transition and guarded build failure, persisted pause/cancel before driver kill with post-kill active-step settlement. Focused tests and 190-test workflow subset pass; mix q passes. Native CI failure is LLMPerformanceFailureTest sandbox-owner shutdown, unrelated by current evidence.

Refined pause/cancel order after review: acquire row lock, persist run and active steps, kill monitored driver, settle any in-flight step writes, then commit. A telemetry-held transaction test now keeps the post-kill commit open until RunWatcher passes its grace and attempts recovery; pause/cancel remain authoritative with no interrupted event.
